tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for your participation. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your food preferences. First, in your opinion, what kinds of meals do people your age enjoy most? Are they traditional, modern, or something in between?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你的参与。今天我想问你一些关于饮食偏好的问题。首先，在你看来，你这个年龄段的人最喜欢什么样的饭菜？是传统风味、现代菜式，还是介于两者之间？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. And what kind of meals do you usually have on busy days-do you cook, eat out, or pick up something ready-made?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。那你在忙碌的时候通常吃什么 —— 是自己做饭、外出就餐，还是买即食食品？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Many people say that modern life has changed how we eat.Do you think people today have healthier eating habits than in the past?Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。很多人说现代生活改变了我们的饮食习惯。你认为现在的人们比过去拥有更健康的饮食习惯吗？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. I just have one more question. Some people believe that preparing traditional meals at home is an important way to stay connected to one's culture. Do you agree, or do you think it's possible to connect with culture in other ways? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。我还有最后一个问题。有些人认为，在家烹制传统菜肴是维系自身文化归属感的重要方式。你是否同意这一观点？还是觉得可以通过其他方式贴近自身文化？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
